root.name: Scotch Game: Napoleon Gambit
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 Nxd4 4. Nxd4 exd4 5. Bc4

overview: After 3...Nxd4 4.Nxd4 exd4 White develops with 5.Bc4 instead of recapturing on d4, offering the pawn. White aims for quick development and pressure on f7. Black can play ...Nf6 or ...c5 and keep the extra pawn.

white_ideas.idea: Play Qxd4, Nc3 and castle while hitting f7

black_ideas.idea: Defend d4 with ...c5 or trade queens

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with a black pawn on d4

character.notes: Open tactical play where White tries to use development.

gambit.notes: Black can hold d4 with ...c5 and keep it.

soundness.notes: Black is fine with accurate play.

sublines_that_differ.name: Normal 5.Qxd4
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 Nxd4 4. Nxd4 exd4 5. Qxd4

gambit.reason: White does not take back on d4.

soundness.reason: Black can keep the pawn and White's compensation is thin.

structure.reason: Open centre with lines for pieces.

plans.reason: Bc4 and fast development aim at f7.
